mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_dd_requirement(requirement_id, case_id, program_requirement_id, status, reused_from_case_id, version, create_time, update_time) VALUES(#{row.requirementId}, #{row.caseId}, #{row.programRequirementId}, #{row.status}, #{row.reusedFromCaseId}, #{row.version}, #{row.createTime}, #{row.updateTime})
mapper.select: SELECT r.requirement_id AS requirementId, r.case_id AS caseId, r.program_requirement_id AS programRequirementId, r.status, r.version, p.requirement_code AS requirementCode, p.required_flag AS requiredFlag, p.max_age_days AS maxAgeDays, p.waivable_flag AS waivableFlag, r.waived_by AS waivedBy, r.waived_reason_code AS waivedReasonCode, r.waived_time AS waivedTime, r.reused_from_case_id AS reusedFromCaseId FROM t_dd_requirement r JOIN t_dd_program_requirement p ON p.program_requirement_id = r.program_requirement_id WHERE r.case_id IN #{id} ORDER BY r.case_id, p.requirement_code
mapper.update: UPDATE t_dd_requirement SET status = #{status}, version = version + 1, update_time = #{now} WHERE requirement_id = #{requirementId} AND version = #{version}

UPDATE t_dd_requirement SET status = 'WAIVED', waived_by = #{actorId}, waived_reason_code = #{reasonCode}, waived_note = #{note}, waived_time = #{now}, version = version + 1, update_time = #{now} WHERE requirement_id = #{requirementId} AND version = #{version} AND status IN ('PENDING', 'RECEIVED', 'REJECTED')
